annotations.text:
The three blueprints, in the platform's own colours and type.

What changed against today: one level of containers (the page is the surface, cards only for objects), rows instead of tiles, the status as a dot and a word instead of a chip, one gold action per screen, quiet uppercase labels only for metadata, and the same rhythm on every screen (40px between sections, 12px rows).

Every screen touched from phase 2 on is built in this look. Say what to change here and it changes everywhere.
